 ORDER

This is the first criminal appeal filed by the appellant under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against the impugned order dated 03.11.2022 passed by Special Judge (Atrocities),
Khandwa (M.P.), whereby the Court below has dismissed the application filed by the appellant under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The appellant is in custody since 13.09.2022 in connection with Crime No.296/2022 registered at Police Station Dhangaon, District Khandwa (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 366,
376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v), 3(2)(va) of the Scheduled Castes &
Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

sentences.text: As per the prosecution, the present appellant committed sexual intercourse with the prosecutrix against her will.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has been falsely implicated.
He has earlier given a loan of Rs.10,000/- to the complainant and when he asked for it back a complaint was lodged by the complainant.
It is pointed out from the FIR that the alleged incident happened on 04.07.2022, however, the report of the incident was lodged on 17.08.2023 i.e., after more than a month.
It is further pointed out that the prosecutrix is a married lady of 22 years and just not to return the amount taken from the appellant has lodged this false report.

It is further pointed out that there is no allegation that the appellant has committed any act with her because she belonged to a particular class nor is there any allegation that the appellant has made casteist remarks against her.
Under such circumstances, no offence under SC/ST Act is made out.

Learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the bail application, however, he does not dispute the fact that the prosecutrix was a major person and has lodged the complaint after a period of one month.
Considering the case diary statements and the contention of learned counsel for the parties, this criminal appeal is allowed.

It is directed that appellant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during the trial.

It is further directed that the appellant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C..
